move.name: Move
move.description: Move eligible selected units to a destination.

attack.name: Attack
attack.description: Attack-move on ground, or force attack a visible damageable target, including friendlies.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Cancel orders and return to autonomous activity. Carried goods remain physical.

build.name: Build
build.description: Place a construction project on explored, clear ground.

produce.name: Produce
produce.description: Train a unit. Reserves its resources and supply immediately.

rally.name: Rally point
rally.description: Choose where newly produced units assemble.

pause.name: Pause production
pause.description: Finish committed work, then release staffing. Resume to request work again.

cancel.name: Cancel construction
cancel.description: Cancel this project and refund its reserved resources to an owned Mound with space.

cancelUpgrade.name: Cancel upgrade
cancelUpgrade.description: Cancel the upgrade and refund the full price.

cancelResearch.name: Cancel research
cancelResearch.description: Cancel this research and refund its full price.

hold.name: Hold Position
hold.description: Stand your ground. Attack enemies within weapon range without chasing.

patrol.name: Patrol
patrol.description: Patrol between the current position and a destination. Engage enemies, then resume patrol.

follow.name: Follow
follow.description: Follow a friendly unit. Right-click a friendly unit to follow it.

unload.name: Leave watchtower
unload.description: Release the archer at the tower entrance. A move order also leaves the lookout.

garrison.name: Enter watchtower
garrison.description: Walk to a friendly watchtower and occupy its single lookout.

category.hero.skills.name: Abilities
category.hero.skills.description: Learn or improve the hero's abilities. The number shows unspent skill points.

back.name: Back
back.description: Return to the previous command category.

camera.name: Cycle camera
camera.description: Follow the selected unit. Cycle RTS, third person and first person. Escape returns to RTS.
